exposure: patient's position during the spinal block
outcome: Incidence of spinal anesthesia complications after cesarean section (hypotension, bradycardia, prolonged recovery)
cohort: Patients who underwent elective cesarean section using spinal anesthesia from January 2019 to December 2020 at a tertiary hospital in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
finding: BMI and the dose of spinal anesthesia were associated with spinal anesthesia-induced hypotension during cesarean section, while the site of the spinal puncture at or below L2 was associated with spinal anesthesia-induced bradycardia.
